system.description:
You attack with a knife in a way that has a greater risk of making an error but gains an additional benefit. Your GM intrusion range for this attack increases by 2 (from 1 on a d20 to 1–3 on a d20), but if you hit you can choose one of the following additional effects:

Deep Slice: The foe takes +2 damage.

Let Them Bleed: The wound bleeds; on your next turn, the foe takes 2 damage that ignores armor.

Action.
